info.name: Mangopay REST Bank Accounts Refunds API

description.content:
The Mangopay REST API enables platforms to manage users, e-wallets, pay-ins, payouts, transfers, foreign exchange, KYC/KYB identity verification, fraud prevention, and dispute handling for multi-party payment flows.
